title: Test automatic MK.2 descriptor reacquisition through a dynamic device view

claims.statement: Verified H-037 evidence establishes that the exact official Companion 4.3.3 image discovered, opened, and reported ready for the exact MK.2 serial when Docker exposed its hidraw node and the non-root SurfaceThread had the host plugdev group; the SurfaceThread owned a matching device descriptor.

Verified H-039 evidence refutes automatic MK.2 reacquisition by the continuously running Companion 4.3.3 stack with a static Docker devices mapping: the exact serial returned in a new enumeration epoch, but no matching SurfaceThread descriptor returned within 30 seconds.

Verified H-040 metadata-only evidence establishes that, across one exact MK.2 enumeration epoch, a read-only dynamic host-device-directory view observed the initial node, exact absence, and the returned host node while a static Docker device mapping retained its original container node identity.

Accepted SPEC-0001 and SPEC-0002 explicitly exclude USB access, Stream Deck discovery, physical key presses, and rendered device pixels, so H-041 is a governed exploratory Slice rather than product acceptance evidence.
claims.evidence: .overlaykit/governance/specifications/SPEC-0001.json and SPEC-0002.json accepted out-of-scope boundaries in the verified compiled plan.

claims.statement: A dynamic hidraw view is a plausible missing boundary between H-039's stale static mapping and Companion recovery, but H-040 did not exercise Companion discovery, application polling, worker lifecycle, device open, or readiness.
claims.evidence: Joint bounded reading of verified H-039 and H-040 evidence; application-level causality remains intentionally unclaimed.

claims.statement: H-041: when the exact official Companion 4.3.3 image retains one unchanged top-level container and PID 1 while seeing current host hidraw nodes through a dynamic directory view with the required device cgroup rule and supplementary group, it automatically reacquires the exact MK.2 after one disconnect and new enumeration epoch within 30 seconds.
claims.evidence: D³ minimal refutation Slice registered before implementation; the governed physical run remains pending.

claims.statement: H-041 does not determine physical button command delivery, OverlayKit configuration continuity, rendered pixels, operator perception, production security acceptance of a broad device-directory bind, or complete production recovery.

No udev rule, systemd unit, supervisor, rescan command, external restart, container recreation, native deployment, reboot, pre-login behavior, multi-device behavior, or OBS truth is established or changed by this Slice.
claims.evidence: H-041 explicit non-intervention and out-of-scope boundary.

successCriteria.statement: Before device I/O, the run binds verified H-037, H-039, and H-040 evidence, the active governance manifest, exact source hashes, exact official Companion image identity, exact Fedora graphical principal, and one present MK.2 serial and hidraw epoch.
successCriteria.verification: Canonical predecessor receipts plus fresh governance, repository, image, login-session, USB, sysfs, hidraw, node-stat, and host-scope owner observations.

successCriteria.statement: One lab-owned official Companion 4.3.3 container starts with a dynamic host-device-directory view, an exact hidraw cgroup rule, the current device supplementary group, and no OverlayKit module or button configuration; baseline evidence proves panel opening, readiness, and a SurfaceThread descriptor matching the current dynamic node.
successCriteria.verification: Exact Docker invocation and inspection, image digest, container and PID 1 identity, process table, descriptor stat, serial-specific Companion logs, and absence of OverlayKit or virtual-invocation tooling.

successCriteria.statement: During one human-bounded disconnect and reconnect, stable host observations prove exact absence and return of the same serial in a new USB, HID, inode, or ctime epoch while the same top-level Companion container and PID 1 remain continuously running without an agent-issued restart or recreate.
successCriteria.verification: Separate challenge windows, three stable host snapshots per transition, monotonic chronology, Docker lifecycle receipts, process start ticks, restart count, and an exact invocation audit.

successCriteria.statement: A supported H-041 outcome requires a complete new host epoch, stable top-level lifecycle, descriptor absence during disconnect, and no later than 30 seconds after stable return a SurfaceThread descriptor matching the current dynamic node plus serial-specific opening and ready log markers newer than the stable disconnected observation; the worker may remain the same or be automatically replaced, but its lifecycle is recorded.
successCriteria.verification: Schema-valid supported outcome whose predicates, time bounds, log delta, process identities, and descriptor-to-node identity are independently recomputed.

successCriteria.statement: A complete stable observation with no matching descriptor and no new ready marker at the end of the reacquisition window refutes H-041; lifecycle drift, incomplete transitions, contradictory observations, or collector failure are inconclusive and cannot be represented as support or refutation.
successCriteria.verification: Fail-closed outcome classifier, negative and contradiction tests, and independent verifier.

successCriteria.statement: Cleanup removes the exact H-041 container, leaves the returned MK.2 present, records host-scope ownership without treating an empty result as global proof, and records that no host or production configuration was changed.
successCriteria.verification: Exact container absence, final stable host snapshot, host-scope fuser receipt, cleanup status, and invocation audit.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0012 records the architectural question, H-041, typed claims, minimal refutation path, observable evidence, exclusions, and reorder before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Before: a full configured OverlayKit/Companion reconnect and physical-command lab. After reorder: an isolated Companion descriptor-reacquisition Slice with no OverlayKit or button.

definitionOfDone.statement: The Slice adds only CHG-0012, bounded directly executable H-041 tooling and tests, physical evidence, and deterministic generated governance artifacts; accepted records and every H-039/H-040 source-bound file remain untouched.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Repository diff plus H-039 and H-040 independent source verification.

definitionOfDone.statement: A physical run produces independently verified supported or refuted H-041 evidence, or records an explicit inconclusive failure without overstating the hypothesis.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Pending physical H-041 run and independent verifier.

definitionOfDone.statement: Governance, quality, build, H-039, H-040, and focused H-041 gates pass under the required Node 22 runtime.

No ADR, specification acceptance, implemented status, merge, installation, udev rule, systemd unit, supervisor, production device bind, or production configuration is created before separate human evidence review and acceptance.
